Confirmed: the internal `store/db/mysql` package (the actual MySQL storage driver implementing `store.Driver`) is imported and its `NewDB` constructor is called in exactly one place — `store/db/db.go`, which is the driver-selection factory (`NewDBDriver`). The `mysql` references in `store/test/containers.go` are to a completely different package (`testcontainers-go/modules/mysql`, a Testcontainers helper for spinning up a MySQL container in tests), not the memos MySQL storage driver.

h04.
No; the only call to the internal MySQL driver's constructor `mysql.NewDB(profile)` in the whole codebase is inside the factory function `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go` (lines 21-22), which imports `store/db/mysql`. A codebase-wide search for imports of `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` (`grep -rn '"github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql"' --include=*.go`) turns up only that one file. The other hits for the string "mysql." outside the `store/db/mysql/` package itself are in `store/test/containers.go`, but that file imports a different package, `mysqldriver "github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"` and `"github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/modules/mysql"` (used to spin up a MySQL test container), not the project's own MySQL driver — so it doesn't count as constructing the memos MySQL `store.Driver` directly. Callers elsewhere (`cmd/memos/main.go:57`, `store/test/store.go:28,50`, `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_benchmark_test.go:70`) all go through `db.NewDBDriver`, not `mysql.NewDB` directly.
